payload.title: Loading Data with PyLiPD and Pyleoclim
payload.description: This workflow demonstrates how to load and process paleoclimate data from LiPD files using the PyLiPD and Pyleoclim libraries. It involves importing necessary packages, loading data into PyLiPD objects, parsing these objects for specific data such as oxygen isotopes, and handling special cases like overlapping timestamps. The processed data is then converted into Pyleoclim objects for improved plotting and saved as a pickle file for future use.

steps.title: Load LiPD Files

steps.description: Parse the loaded PyLiPD object to extract oxygen isotope data and save it into a dictionary.
steps.title: Parse Oxygen Isotopes

steps.description: Handle special cases such as the 'dongge' record which contains two overlapping records, and combine values for overlapping timestamps.
steps.title: Handle Special Cases

steps.description: Convert the parsed data into Pyleoclim objects for improved plotting.
steps.title: Convert to Pyleoclim Objects
